full_description:
Client & Business Services
Location: Warszawa, Puławska 2
Employment type: contract of employment
Work model: hybryd - at least 2 days in the office per week
We’re looking for an experienced professional to oversee daily middle‑office operations across onshore and offshore teams. In this role, you’ll supervise distributed teams, ensure strong operational controls, and act as the second level of escalation for key processes. You’ll lead the end‑to‑end onboarding of new funds, portfolios and mandates into our operational and OMS setup, while managing core OMS configuration and data flows. The role also involves coordinating system enhancements with clients and vendors and driving continuous improvements across workflows and controls.
Your main responsibilities
you support the operational teams (onshore and offshore) across Investment Operations / Middle Office processes (data management, IBOR, trade operations, asset servicing, reconciliations etc.)
you supervise the operational teams (onshore and offshore) ensuring aligned responsibilities, effective knowledge transfer, high-quality output and adherence to SLAs and controls
you ensure segragation of duties (SoD) and operational risk controls are maintined across all processes
you own and lead end-to-end operational configuration and control of key OMS components (portfolio setup and lifecycle, trade workflows, instrument setup, pricing and reference data flows, counterparty and settlement instructions)
you oordinate with clients & vendors on system enhancements and interface upgrades (incl. close collaboration with OMS platform vendor for change management)
you repare management reports and KPI dashboards, implement new controls, KPIs and quality standards
you serve as the second level of escalation in case of issues
you have 5+ years experience in investment operations/middle-office within asset management, fund administration or custody
you have practical wide experience with trade lifcycle across asset classes, asset servicing and corporate actions, reconciliations, pricing and data management, SWIFT
you have ractical experience  in OMS configuration, understadning of OMS functionality and operational data flow, 3rd party trade processing supporting platforms (OMGEO, DTC Trade Suite, MarginSphere, MarkitWire etc.)
you have a strong knowledge of investment processes, financial instruments and pricing
you understand market standards and frameworks (incl. UCITS, AIFMD, EMIR, ESMA, KNF etc.)
you have pracitcal experience collaborating with FO (portfolio managers, traders), Risk, Compliance and 3rd party vendors within asset management
you are excellent at communication
you are able to work in fast-paces, high-volume environements
you speak Polish fluently (C1 level at least)
you have a good level of English (daily communication with offshore team)
you know Blackrock Aladdin platform
you have experience with OMS systems implementation, participation in services / processes transition projects
you have experience working with offshore team
We invest in development - we offer co-financing for training and courses as well as access to educational platforms: Udemy Business, e-Tutor, and an internal e-learning platform. We also offer development internships and consultations with career advisors.
We care about health and safety - we offer a medical package and life insurance for you and your loved ones, access to the Mindgram platform with individual consultations with specialists and webinars. While working at ING, you have the opportunity to join the Employee Pension Program and the Oncological Prevention Program.
In practice, work life balance means additional days off: "family day" (it's up to you how you use it), days off in the form of rewards and free hours for volunteering or health prevention.
For parents, we have additional days of maternity and paternity leave and days off for child care, regardless of the limit used by the other parent.
By joining us, you decide to work in a stable organization focused on comfortable working conditions with a Top Employer certificate. The future is our joint investment - together with ING you can get involved in any initiative supporting ESG and social responsibility.
You decide what equipment you work with. We provide each employee with the necessary equipment for work, but if you want to work on a laptop or smartphone of your choice, which you will also use for your private purposes, we provide such an opportunity. We offer a refund and discount program on selected purchases.
We celebrate together and get to know each other during team trips, family and sports events, such as Children's Day, Run Warsaw or sports tournaments.
Green office spaces for work and meetings, as well as places to relax - all at your disposal.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
